To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The construction process has a flow nature and can be described in terms of flow models.
“Construction Physics is the science of the flow of resources and activities that are prerequisites to construction, and that are necessary to produce the desired construction outcome”.

1) Construction Physics is a comprehensive theory for the flow of the construction process; 2) Construction Physics is the study of the construction process as a system of flows; and 3) the Critical Flow is the flow of all the resources feeding the construction process.
In summary, our research is concerned with

how to improve the performance of the construction process by understanding and controlling the flow of all its prerequisites, and how to manage the process to ensure that it is always operating within its Critical Flow.
developing a theory and a model of construction physics and its application to the management of the flow of construction processes.
developing a comprehensive flow theory for construction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the present knowledge on the subject is not sufficient to fully support the management of the construction process and that there is a clear need to develop and investigate further the concept of Construction Flow Theory.
the construction flow theory is not yet established and that the research and development of such a theory is a long term task that should be undertaken by a group of researchers.
the construction flow is not yet well understood and that the state of knowledge is insufficient for the development of a comprehensive theory.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are now in the position to start developing a construction flow theory.
we have identified the need for an overall flow model for the construction process and that the Critical Flow concept is a promising way forward.
we are now able to identify a number of critical flows and to develop methods for their management.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the construction process is not just about the physical flow of materials, but rather the flow of all resources, including information and knowledge.
the current state of the art in flow management does not cover the whole construction process.
the current flow management methods and tools do not address the whole construction process, and therefore, the flow of all the prerequisites feeding the process should be investigated.
